newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Cimpor hits high after acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Cimpor hits high after acquisitions.

text.p: Shares of Portuguese cement producer Cimpor-Cimentos de Portugal hit an all-time high of 3,925 escudos on Lisbon bourse after news it had acquired two Brazilian cement businesses.
Dealers said the share could hit 4,000 escudos this quarter.
Cimpor eased back to 3,832 escudos, up 44, in heavy volume of 392,900 shares at 1104 GMT.
"4,000 escudos is a credible objective, not today, but the share is heading in that direction," said a dealer who asked not to be identified.
One operator said: "Cimpor opened sharply higher on the news of the acquisitions of the Brazilian cement businesses, and then started to correct."
Another dealer said: "There was some euphoria on today's news about the acquisitions, but the share later eased back on profit taking."

Cimpor, Portugal's biggest cement producer, said it had acquired two Brazilian cement businesses for 62 billion escudos ($394 million). It said it had acquired CISAFRA, a cement producer, and the SERRANA group's cement business.
